items.headline: Manchester United lose Carabao Cup tie to Brighton 3-2 after being 2-0 up
items.summary: Michael Carrick's side surrendered a two-goal lead to lose 3-2 to Brighton in the Carabao Cup on September 16.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel in Barcelona talks after requesting Manchester United exit
items.summary: 15-year-old academy prospect JJ Gabriel flew to Catalonia for talks with Barcelona after pushing for a move away from United.
